title: Eagles Over London
writer: Tito Carpi, Vincenzo Mannino, José Luis Martínez Mollá
actors: Frederick Stafford, Van Johnson, Francisco Rabal
plot: In World War II, a German undercover unit infiltrates British lines during the evacuation of Dunkirk, 1940. The film revolves around their successes and failures in disrupting Royal Air Force operations during the Battle of Britain.
